variants.name: Inhabited frontage
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: environment concept paintover for a stylized 3D video-game town menu, Respite.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the approved actual render. Preserve its exact elevated oblique camera, crop, perspective, positions, sizes, rotations and silhouettes of ALL FIVE destinations. Image 2 supplies ONLY the quality of scuffed materials and architectural connections, NOT its layout or buildings. Image 3 supplies ONLY broad soft painted scuffs and simple beveled geometry, NOT its characters, orange palette or arena.
LOCKED composition from image 1: horseshoe bazaar in LEFT FOREGROUND, complete three wings and BOTH entrance returns, with plum awnings and empty simple vendor counters; open vault stash immediately behind it toward image center-left; compact Codex farther back left of the tunnel; circular cyan exit embedded in the CONTINUOUS solid wall with tower immediately to its RIGHT; single-drum forge farther right beside the tower, its amber horizontal slit and roof pipes unchanged. Keep every entrance visible and approachable. Do not move the market back to the right! Keep the wall continuous on BOTH sides of the tunnel and extending beyond both frame edges. Retain giant curved machinery beyond the wall. The tunnel goes INTO the solid wall, never a freestanding ring.
PRIMARY REQUEST: Design ONLY the secondary environment around these fixed buildings, filling the currently bare outer LEFT area and tying the buildings to a coherent plaza. Preserve the broad clear CENTRAL court, uninterrupted foreground ground and clear short approach to the exit. Preserve the large empty RIGHT FOREGROUND as a useful future building plot: paving may articulate it, but no structure occupies it. New secondary architecture sits BEHIND/outside the left buildings or against the rear wall, subordinate in height, light and contrast. Avoid fake interactive destinations.
Art direction: human-maintained town within ancient partly autonomous machine infrastructure; inhabited without any visible people, robots or animals. Economical game geometry, believable broad volumes, soft bevels, large matte paint scuffs; no tiny products, machinery greebles, scattered junk or photographic grit. Charcoal and slate materials, navy/cobalt/violet atmosphere, restrained warm-white local light. Exit cyan is the main focal light; Codex lilac, forge amber, market plum remain distinct. Use modest layered fog behind the destinations but retain readable ground and material treatment. Comparable light and fog across this set, so architecture carries the variation. Maintain darkness between light pools. No toy-coloured panels, uniform neon outlines, glossy wet paving, huge foreground walls, cliff edges, centre statue, fountain, vehicles, trees, or UI.
Output ONE full-width landscape paintover matching image 1 aspect ratio, about 2:1. No sheet, collage, text, labels or watermark. Preserve the edit target's main building geometry faithfully.
VARIATION: A small lived-in neighborhood continues BEHIND the bazaar and stash on the left, well outside the central court. Use a low, irregular row of three attached service/habitation volumes with differing roof heights, broad blank wall panels, just a few sheened slit windows and modest warm recessed lights. Let the row disappear beyond the left crop so this feels like a fragment of a larger town. A narrow side lane, visible between these secondary volumes and the destination buildings, joins the court through existing gaps; all main gaps remain walkable. Ground-level service connections and consistent shallow paving aprons unite the buildings. No balconies, no shop signs, no detailed interiors. Make the left edge feel settled and cared for without crowding the destinations.
